title: lint: refuse the three never-offered transferBehavior: 'cascade' shapes at the runtime publish gate too (Studio and MCP saves), not only in os validate / build / lint
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Filing gate: ① a declared-but-not-enforced authoring path with a named landing (ADR-0049) · Source: fleet (L1 S2 of seat repo:objectstack#5 on PR #37382, comment 7180284087; contract record 7180267565). Follow-up of #36714; carries the publish-gate half #36714 left out.

Grading: `area:data` · Task · p3 · reach: read on PR #37382's diff — `validateTransferCascades` is registered `surfaces: CLI_ONLY` with a written `surfaceReason`, so a Studio or MCP save of the three shapes still succeeds; the runtime never offers them (Change Owner re-judges every relation), so nothing wrong happens at runtime · evidence: read.
Suggested-grade: p3 · author-time signal missing on two save doors; runtime safe.

## What
PR #37382 (#36714) adds the lint rule `validateTransferCascades`, refusing at error in `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`:
- `transfer-cascade-parent-without-change-owner`
- `transfer-cascade-extension-child-ineligible`
- `transfer-cascade-child-update-unexposed`
It is CLI-only because the served objects at the publish door carry the injected `owner_id`, which the eligibility predicate reads; the dev did not measure whether the verdict is stable there.

## Ask
1. Measure on the publish door's served definitions whether `transferIneligibilityReason` / `changeOwnerOffReason` give the same verdict as on the authored stack. The contract record's reading: `resolveInjectedSystemColumns` / `resolveInjectedColumnProvenance` are built to give one verdict pre- and post-injection, so the obstacle may be smaller than the rule's `surfaceReason` says.
2. If stable, move the rule onto the runtime publish gate (the surfaces Studio and MCP saves pass through) and update the three places that say it is CLI-only: the rule's `surfaceReason`, its `os explain` entry, and the changeset / docs line PR #37382 wrote.
3. If not stable, record the measured reason in the `surfaceReason` and close this card.

## Done when
A Studio or MCP save of each of the three shapes is refused with the same rule id and message as `os validate`, or the card closes with the measured reason recorded.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue transferBehavior publish gate` → checked before filing; none open (nearest: #36714 itself, #36713 closed skills).
Reader: triage first touch; then any seat taking area:data.
Order: after PR #37382 merges.
